title: Khamari returns with a new single, "Drifting"
htmlContent:
A multifaceted self-dependent singer-songwriter and producer, Khamari. This rising star has been perfecting his skill for some time to push the peripheries of his sound and authentically create his music.

Khamari's return with his first release in almost a year in an ode to the challenges of living in the juncture, "Drifting," showcases a confidently breezy flow with a beautifully incorporated sample of Nina Simone's chopped vocals degraded throughout. Khamari exhibits a rhythm that allows the listener to feel the lyricism and energy of the record.

Khamari's "Drifting" is now available for streaming on all music outlets.
